aggregate_markers: portfolio investments and cash and cash equivalents

senior_secured_debt.description: Term loans, revolvers, and other senior secured debt

equity.description: Equity investments including common/preferred stock, LLC interests, and fund interests

known_edge_cases.description: Control Investments entity-level subtotal rows that duplicate the sum of underlying Portfolio Company positions
Affiliate Investments entity-level subtotal rows that duplicate the sum of underlying Portfolio Company positions
Standalone reference rate rows (SOFR, Prime, CORRA, Bank of England Base Rate) with no fair value - metadata only
Formation Transactions row with zero fair value - not a real position
Foreign Currency Forward Contracts counterparty metadata row
Combined Control and Affiliate Investments total row - top-level subtotal across both categories
Sector-level subtotal rows (e.g., "Portfolio Company Debt Securities- United States Consumer Products & Services" without position detail)
known_edge_cases.detection_pattern: ^Portfolio Company (?:Debt Securities|Warrant Investments|Equity Investments)-\s+(?:United States|Canada|Europe|United Sates)(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z &(),/"]+)?$

known_edge_cases.description: Issuer-level total rows (e.g., "Total Bestow, Inc.") appearing in early quarters
Grand total rows: Investment in Securities, Portfolio Investments and Cash, Portfolio Company Debt Securities (bare)
Cash and cash equivalents rows (Goldman Sachs fund, other cash accounts, restricted cash)
LIBOR reference rate row in early quarters
Issuer-level or sector-level rollup rows for debt that lack position-level detail (no Type of Investment, Secured Loan, Equipment Financing, etc.). These aggregate underlying position rows.
Truncated debt identifier row missing Portfolio Company prefix
Rows with truncated or missing Portfolio Company prefix (e.g., ortfolio, Investments-)
XBRL metadata identifiers (InvestmentOwnedAtCost) that are not positions
Standalone interest rate description rows (Variable interest rate...)

staging.notes: 2026-09-06: 'Portfolio Company <Section>- <Region> <Industry> <Company> Type of Investment ...' dialect; 5,008/5,065 cohort rows were unparsed (mg3 F1). Industry labels are Trinity's own vocabulary derived from its identifiers (trinity_industries.py, 38 labels, cleaned to 30) and kept inline so they do not enter the global MSD_INDUSTRY_LABELS union. Probe: 99.1% of rows extract. 2026-09-07: instrument keeps 'Investment Date ...' and warrants their 'Series ...' tail (trailing_re) because several draws on one company differ only by investment date; without it 62 rows / $83.3M FV collapsed under the filing-level dedup keys in the first rebuild.
